comments.author: @stevepippin6580
comments.text: As AI videos go this is one of the better ones. That said you really didn't show what it's truly like to live there. It mentioned some of the challenges and glossed over the rest. The same government that wants the young people to stay are the ones engaged in the corruption that's making it impossible to have a decent standard of living. I lived there long enough to say I lived there and I'm thankful and grateful for all of my experiences there, that said I never want to live that close to the ground again. Most people and business have generators out of necessity and the people maintaining them are not paid a living wage. The maintenance crews keeping the massive properties full of air bombs don't fare much better. Owning a home there isn't out of reach because of prices there out of reach because getting a mortgage there isn't at all as easy as it is on the mainland. I wouldn't trade my time there for anything but I would love to see a video that shows the real St. Thomas.
